title: Maria and Carlos
text:
Maria is a doctor. She works at a hospital in the city. She helps sick people every day. She starts work at eight in the morning.

Her brother, Carlos, is a teacher. He teaches math at a school. He likes his students very much. After work, he plays football with his friends.

questions.text: How does Maria probably feel about her job?
options: She wants to be a teacher

questions.text: What kind of person is Carlos probably?

vocabulary.definition: a place where doctors help sick people
a person who teaches at a school
people who learn at a school

paragraph_translations: María es doctora. Trabaja en un hospital de la ciudad. Ayuda a personas enfermas todos los días. Empieza a trabajar a las ocho de la mañana.
Su hermano, Carlos, es maestro. Enseña matemáticas en una escuela. Le gustan mucho sus estudiantes. Después del trabajo, juega al fútbol con sus amigos.
